events_<YYYYMMDD>: Entity: analytics events captured on a single day; Grain: one row per recorded event (columns event_date + event_timestamp/event_server_timestamp_offset indicate timing); Notable measures/keys: event_name, event_timestamp, event_previous_timestamp, event_value_in_usd, event_bundle_sequence_id; user identifiers: user_id, user_pseudo_id; event details/metadata: event_params, event_dimensions, ecommerce, items; user context: user_properties, user_first_touch_timestamp, user_ltv, privacy_info; device/app/geo/traffic: device, geo, app_info, traffic_source, platform, stream_id.
